name: How do plumbers fix a severe toilet clog?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers fix a severe toilet clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: For severe toilet clogs, plumbers typically use professional tools like a toilet auger or drain snake to physically break up or retrieve the obstruction. If the clog is deep within the main sewer line, they might use a larger auger or hydro-jetting equipment, which uses high-pressure water to clear blockages and clean the pipes. They may also inspect the line with a camera to identify the exact cause.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers use tools like augers or drain snakes for severe clogs, or hydro-jetting for main line issues, sometimes with camera inspection.
